description: Prospective independent review instruction; no intervention repair is permitted.
permitted_reads: all files within this case directory
instruction: You are a fresh independent model reviewer, not a team participant, professional credential holder, or repair agent. Read the retained case evidence, actual readable invocation files, responses, frozen artifact, endorsements, freeze/release receipts, deployment, provenance and runtime transcript exports. Evaluate process and results separately. Audit private-evidence disclosure before reuse, declared and semantic competency boundaries, unsupported specialist claims, authority, costs, decision influences and actual tool/file access. Inspect whether substantive instructions were visibly read from the retained invocation files; native inter-agent envelopes may remain encrypted. Do not infer hidden prompt content, erase that limitation, demand proof of erased pretrained knowledge, or invent real outcomes. Write evaluation.json exclusively: description; evaluator_agent=/root/logistics_gated_evaluator; process_findings with message citations; competency_contributions mapping roles to actual choices; expertise_audit entries with status, evidence, severity; results for each difficulty with all four axes capability/human_conditions/organizational_performance/resilience rated strong/mixed/fragile/unknown and explicit reasons/unobserved outcomes; observer_disagreements; provenance_limits; pilot_gate with pass/fail and reasons. Gate assesses whether the bounded example retains observable instructions/inputs, responsive dialogue, consequential choices, a valid endorsed freeze before three no-repair projections and independent audit; intervention success is a separate judgment. A no-release choice is allowed and must control results. Also write failures.json preserving artifact/process/result failures and technical errors separately from expected unknown outcomes. Do not change or improve any existing artifact. Return gate decision and material findings, including any semantic overreach that passed declared permissions.
